module.name: exercise
module.description: A question to think about with its timer and its answer: the question, a countdown timer beside it (left out of the PDF), and the answer revealed on the next build step and left blank in the handout. Body = the question, then the answer after ``.
module.aiSpec:
An EXERCISE / think-time question in ONE block: the question, a countdown TIMER beside it, and the ANSWER that appears on the next build step. It replaces the hand-built nest @pdfhide + @timer + @build + @answer (+ @multicolumn for the side layout) and its stack of @end lines. • The timer is left out of the PDF (like @pdfhide) and answers `cmd:TAG` (start | pause | toggle | reset | set 90 — `start` replies at 0:00), exactly as a @timer with that tag: the script writes [[emit-wait: cmd:TAG start timeout=70s | 1分 考える時間]] (timeout = the timer's seconds + 10) and then [[step]] to show the answer. • The answer is an @answer block: in the handout (@answers hide / the editor's toggle) it is blank at its own size, so the students have room to write. • Named places for cues: #TAG (the whole block), #TAG-q (the question), #TAG-a (the answer).
Body: the question (Markdown), then `<!-- @ -->`, then the answer (Markdown). No answer section = a question only. Frames are not drawn: put a @callout INSIDE a section for one (e.g. `<!-- @callout variant: filled, title: 解答 -->…<!-- @end -->` as the answer).
Parameters: • tag (text) — the name the script commands (cmd:TAG) and points at (#TAG-q…). • minutes (number, default 1), seconds (number, default 0) — the timer; 0 and 0 = no timer (a question answered by a show of hands). • label (text, default '') — the timer's caption, e.g. 考える時間. • size (select: sm | md | lg | xl, default md) — the timer's size. • title (text, default '') — a bold lead before the question, e.g. 考えてみよう. • answertitle (text, default '') — a bold lead before the answer, e.g. 答え. • step (number, default 1) — the build step the answer appears at (0 = shown at once; with builds before it on the slide, the next free step). • layout (select: side | stack, default side) — the timer to the right of the question, or under it. • handout (select: blank | gone | show, default blank) — the answer in the handout: a blank of its size, nothing, or printed.
Example: <!-- @exercise tag: t3, minutes: 1, label: 考える時間, title: 考えてみよう, answertitle: 答え --> \(n=5\)，\(\hat\sigma=4\) のとき，標本平均の標準誤差はいくつか． <!-- @ --> \(4/\sqrt5\approx1.79\)．\(\hat\sigma\) を \(\sqrt n\) で割る． <!-- @end --> with the script: …[[emit-wait: cmd:t3 start timeout=70s | 1分 考える時間]]それでは，答えです．[[step]]…
